evals.expected_output: The run selects the Markdown adapter, captures the local source revision, and normalizes the actual headings, paragraphs, comparison table, links, two images, and both Mermaid blocks in order. expectations: The actual comparison table, repository-relative links, local images, and both Mermaid blocks appear in the normalized inventory.

A missing local Mermaid renderer is reported as a limitation; no live page write or stored readback is claimed.

evals.prompt: SIMULATION ONLY — do not access or modify a hosted service. Use `evals/files/local-update-simulation/source.html` as the full source and `evals/files/local-update-simulation/current-page.html` as the complete current page snapshot. Use `simulation.json` only as static fixture metadata, not as evidence of live versions. Exclude the source's site navigation and cookie banner as application chrome, and record those omissions. Replace only the section marked `data-source-section="service-report"`. Retain the current table of contents, page-only note and table, and legacy image. Use a 240-pixel display width for both source images. Prepare a complete proposed body and an operation plan; do not claim that anything was saved. If the local diagram renderer is unavailable, report that and leave those diagrams unresolved.
evals.expected_output: The run uses the HTML source adapter, records the excluded navigation and cookie banner as intentional omissions, and reads the entire current-page snapshot. It always reads the full `confluence-body.md` reference before constructing the body, plus attachments and diagrams references because both source and current page contain relevant assets. It measures both source images at the shared 240-pixel display width, preserves their aspect ratios, and retains each result. If the local renderer is available and succeeds, it captures both matching diagram elements and visually inspects every rendered image. If unavailable or a capture fails, it reports that rendering is incomplete and does not claim the proposed page is ready for publication. The proposed complete body retains the existing TOC identifier, page-only note, page-only table, and legacy image. Source parity and body structure are validated. The result stays a simulation: it records the fixture's source revision and page version but leaves the live version check, upload, save, and stored-page readback pending.
expectations: The proposed update preserves every current-page construct outside the marked source section, including the existing TOC identifier and legacy attachment.
Both source images use the requested 240-pixel display width, keep their aspect ratios, and retain separate measurement results.
Every successfully rendered diagram image is inspected; incomplete or unavailable rendering remains unresolved.
The operation plan puts each required asset upload before the body's reference to that asset.
The output does not claim a live version check, upload, save, or stored-result readback.
